name: TrenTorch
notes: Write every algorithm from scratch, from linear regression, neural networks, RL and inference to kernels, and see exactly what your code does at every step. 1647+ problems with theory and practical explanation. Free. No subscriptions. Powered by sponsors and donations.

name: NeetCode
notes: Contains roadmap and practice questions for Algorithms, Database, System Design, Low Level Design and Machine Learning. Algorithmic questions are tagged with Company (Pro feature)

name: AceDevHub
notes: Mostly focused on learning JS and TS (excellent and essential theory with example code). Also has projects to try. Has roadmaps. Contains very good interview questions on JS and TS.

name: Exercism
notes: Tracks on all programming languages, with starting from basics to algorithms. Mostly implementation questions to gain mastery over a language. Includes scripting languages as well.

name: Interview Desk
notes: Interview question for everything backend related: security, databases, distributed systems, caching, messaging queues, networking & APIs, infra, reliability, scaling, performance, observability, devops.

name: ScaleDojo
notes: The learning track here includes Algorithmic Fundamentals (Python) + Python language concepts, HLD Fundamentals, LLD Fundamentals, API Design Fundamentals, AI Engineering Fundamentals.
